datasets.name: bimanual-cube-new-failure-case

task.description: Bimanual cube grasping failure-case demonstrations collected on or after 2026-07-07, with incomplete wrist-depth episodes removed.

notes: This v2.2 derivative removes every episode with a wrist-depth stream whose frame count does not equal the episode RGB frame count.
Removed pre-cleanup episode indices are 2, 3, and 6; output episode indices are rebuilt as contiguous 0..3.
Wrist final keep-masks are generated externally and used only for training-time background augmentation.
